Title: Genji Hotfix Patch #1
Subtitle: Bug fixes for patch 2.25.1.52986 (April 28, 2017), addressing client crashes, localized text/notifications, UI issues, profile win-rate tooltips, and level 5 Gem reward notifications.
Highlights: Bug fixes for patch 2.25.1.52986 (April 28, 2017), addressing client crashes, localized text/notifications, UI issues, profile win-rate tooltips, and level 5 Gem reward notifications.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Resolved a game client crash issue.
  • Prevented text truncation on the Korean client's Gem purchase screen.
  • Fixed a localization mistake on the Taiwanese client's Veteran Loot Chest reward popup.
  • Blocked access to the Collection screen while inside draft lobbies.
  • Resolved an issue where New Talent prompts could fail to show when unlocking a new tier.
  • Fixed Party Frames disappearing during Tutorial matches.
  • Fixed profile statistics hover tooltips so Hero loss counts display properly alongside win rates.
  • Fixed missing notifications for earning 1,000 Gems upon reaching player level 5.
